meta_description:
1,129 likes, 15 comments - passionpassport on April 11, 2022: "Join us on an unforgettable hike through Johnston Canyon!

Carved into the limestone by thousands of years of erosion, Johnston Canyon is absolutely breathtaking. Overhanging canyon walls, waterfalls, the deep ink pot spring pools, and lush forest are sure to leave a memorable impression on visitors. 

#passionpassport #canada #banff".
